definitions.explanation: Having a large quantity or variety; well-supplied.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊富|ほうふ}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: We're looking for someone with rich experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊富|ほうふ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This region is rich in resources.

examples.japanese: {豊富|ほうふ}な⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自慢|じまん}→自慢：03278_jiman⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: We pride ourselves on our abundant selection.

notes:
USAGE: {豊富|ほうふ} emphasizes both quantity and quality, often implying a rich variety.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{豊富|ほうふ}な〜 (abundant ~)
・〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊富|ほうふ} (~ is abundant)
・⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧{豊富|ほうふ} (rich in experience)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊富|ほうふ} (rich in experience)
・⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊富|ほうふ} (rich in resources)
・⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{豊富|ほうふ} (rich in knowledge)

ANTONYM: ⟦{乏|とぼ}しい→乏しい：08153_toboshii⟧ (scarce, lacking)
